stage: the gate scan is scoped to the selected campaign
answer_to_review: Codex is right twice. (1) The catalogs were the selected campaign's, but ReferencedIds scanned the WHOLE workspace, so another campaign's conditions could be blamed on this one. The scan now reads only that campaign's manifest and the files of the modules that manifest names, resolved through the shared module-folder mapping, exactly as the compiler's input hash does. (2) The no-book message is NOT a gate: the method returns no findings and the notes carry the state.

verified.own_campaign: the fullgame scan still finds its own seventeen unreachable gates, so the scoping did not hide the real finding
verified.two_campaign_test: a synthetic workspace with two campaigns proves the fix: campaign a's module reads its own fact while campaign b's module reads a different one, and each campaign reports ZERO gates - previously a would have been blamed for b's id. After b's book is given a different fact, ONLY b reports one gate and a still reports none
verified.no_book: a campaign with no book returns NO gates rather than a 'catalogs not read' finding
